feedback: The current geometry with sensor spread ±0.04 m and sensor size 0.016 m provides stable sensing and reduced noise compared to wider spreads, but the robot still experiences line loss and off-track failures, especially on the s-bend track. The integrator had to compensate by tuning controller gains and reducing base speed to maintain control. The sensor positions close to the axle maintain stable sensing. To improve, narrowing the sensor spread further to ±0.035 m should reduce noise and improve control stability. Increasing the integral gain ki to 1.2 will enhance integral correction to reduce steady-state error. Lowering the base speed to 1.0 balances control and progress, reducing overshoot and off-track risk. These changes should reduce line loss events and improve completion and accuracy on complex tracks.
